description: This file defines a static class 'AssetFlows' which provides CRUD operations and related functionality for managing assets, including creation, reading, updating, querying, and soft deletion. It also contains custom exception classes and record types for request/response modeling, integrating with a repository pattern and logging.

classes.name: AssetFlows.DuplicatePermitEuIdException
classes.description: Custom exception thrown when attempting to create/update an asset with a Permit EU ID that already exists.

methods.name: CreateAssetAsync
methods.description: Creates an asset by performing duplicate permit ID check, inserting into database, and returning the created asset.

methods.name: GetAssetAsync
methods.description: Fetches an asset by ID, excluding soft-deleted ones.

methods.name: UpdateAssetAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing asset, ensuring uniqueness of Permit EU ID.

methods.name: QueryAssetsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a list of assets based on provided filters.

methods.name: DeleteAssetAsync
methods.description: Soft-deletes an asset and its dependent records in a transaction.
